emails.subject: Harlow v. Kestrel — consulting expert scheduling for Apr 29 conference
emails.body:
Hi Nadia,

Confirming the consulting expert engagement for the Apr 29 Harlow case strategy conference. Dr. Helen Voss (actuator-failure engineering) and Dr. Samuel Ortiz (forensic data analysis) are booked for the 14:00–14:35 PT segment only. Both have a hard stop at 14:35 for a deposition in another matter, so please plan the agenda so their findings come first. Their time is billed per segment under the existing engagement letters.

Also a reminder that the expert designation deadline under the scheduling order is May 30.

— Bennett & Crane Litigation Support

emails.subject: Harlow — settlement authority before the May 12 mediation
emails.body:
Nadia —

I'm sending this only to you and Daniel so counsel knows where the board has landed. The mediation is May 12. After yesterday's board session I've been authorized to approve a settlement range if the mediation moves in that direction. Thomas has the details and can walk you through them.

Let's regroup the Friday after the mediation.

— Gerald

emails.subject: Harlow — draft declarations uploaded for case-team review
emails.body:
Hi Nadia,

The draft declarations for the summary-judgment filing are now in the DMS under the Harlow matter workspace:

  • Declaration of Kestrel QA Lead — draft v3, redline against v2 included
  • Declaration of Kestrel Field Technician — draft v1

Please route comments through the DMS so the case team can see them before filing. Standard handling reminder: draft declarations are attorney work product. Keep drafts inside the matter workspace. Circulate final versions only once they are executed.

— Bennett & Crane Litigation Support

emails.subject: Re: Harlow conference agenda
emails.body:
Nadia — for Tuesday's conference, once the expert segment wraps I'd like to walk through the SJ motion outline, especially the causation section, and lock the deposition schedule for Harlow's engineer. Opposing counsel still hasn't confirmed dates. 30 min on our side should cover it.

Happy to talk through anything beforehand as well.

— Daniel

emails.subject: SJ filing deadline + cite check
emails.body:
Hi Nadia — for your calendar, the SJ filing position is due in two days after Tuesday's conference. I'm midway through the cite check on the brief. Two of the product-liability cases in the causation section need updated subsequent-history flags, and I'll have those cleaned up before the conference. Let me know if you want the table of authorities earlier.

— Rachel

emails.subject: Supplemental report — timing question
emails.body:
Hi Nadia — so I can plan, when should I expect a go/no-go on the supplemental report, and when should I send the next invoice? I'm scheduling other engagements for June and the timing matters. No rush, just checking.

Thanks!
— Helen
